in_hebrew.name: Holman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Holman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Holman is of Anglo-Saxon origin and translates to 'holy man'. This name was given to children born to families who held strong Christian beliefs and wanted to honor their faith. In the Bible, there are several holy men, such as St. Holman, a 6th-century Irish bishop, and St. Holman of Trier, who was a 4th-century bishop in the Roman Empire. The name Holman is a reminder of the importance of faith and spirituality in our lives.
